title: Forbidden Memories rules
description: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories' duel rules for the Forbidden Memories mod: no Tributes, and fusion from the hand step by step without Polymerization (Fuse on a hand monster's menu). Reads the mod's fm.json. Work in progress, logs every step.

settings.title: Fusions in the main deck
settings.help: Fusion monsters are main deck cards, Normal Summoned or Set from the hand like any monster, as in Forbidden Memories (there is no Extra Deck).

settings.title: No Tributes
settings.help: Any monster can be Normal Summoned or Set without Tributes, as in Forbidden Memories (one Normal Summon per turn stays).
